_comment: Per-VM oc-li deployment config. The account IDENTITY (member_id/vanity/name) is auto-derived at login via the listener's [self] emit — do NOT set it here. Only deploy POLICY lives here.
label: clientname-production

_reply_policy_options.allowlist: only members in `allowlist` get a real reply — use for a real account you don't want fully auto-engaged, or for testing (start here on every new deploy)
_reply_policy_options.all_leads: reply to anyone the engine engages; the engine's CRM lead-lookup already gates (unknown senders → no reply). The normal production mode once the account is cleared.

_engine_comment: The existing reply engine glue on this VM (engagement.py + auto_reply via the OC router). Point at whatever engine this account uses; must read {member_id,chat_id,text} on stdin and print {reply,action} JSON.
